steps.what: Study different techniques through demonstrations, practice and reflection on artistic application

tasks.design: Retain the artist's study and practical exploration. {DOCS} can hold references, while understanding materials and techniques remains fully counted.
tasks.previous_blocker: Technique knowledge develops through experience and artistic judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: No replacement of learning time is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: Translating a demonstrated technique into the artist's own work.

evidence.claim: Image generation does not establish reduced practical technique-learning time.

assumptions: Scope is actual learning, without invented reference administration.
No structured skill or mastery flag is assumed.
Existing references suffice without new software.
research_questions: Which techniques require direct practical demonstration?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross=net=0%. Learning time remains.

tasks.short: Follow art activities and research subjects

steps.what: Monitor events and trends, research subjects, attend exhibitions and read art publications

tasks.design: Retain exhibition visits, reading and subject research as the artist's experience. Existing {DOCS} stores references, but a digest does not replace looking, reading and developing ideas.
tasks.previous_blocker: Artistic relevance depends on personal interpretation and unexpected connections.
tasks.enabler_now: No repeatable clerical component is established for automation here.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising a useful idea without narrowing discovery to familiar patterns.
tasks.human_edge: Attention, curiosity and an individual artistic perspective.

reach.learn: Different interpretations of current artistic work

evidence.claim: Reference summaries do not establish a reduction in exhibition experience or artistic subject research.

assumptions: Scope includes direct experience and interpretation, without an invented newsletter-handling baseline.
No automatic relevance or artistic-value score is produced.
Unchanged research means no new upkeep.
research_questions: Is there repeated source handling distinct from artistic reading and observation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=net=0%; direct research and idea development remain.

tasks.short: Render drawings and illustrations from references

steps.what: Study sketches, blueprints and references and establish the intended drawing
Explore preliminary drawings and illustrations against the intended composition

loop.purpose: Produce optional visual studies for the artist's assessment
loop.input: Checked brief and permitted reference images
loop.output: At most three labelled visual studies
loop.check: Artist checks composition, reference fidelity, proportions and whether invented detail changes the intended subject
loop.stop: One generation and one revision; unsuitable studies lead to manual sketching
loop.why_not_simpler: Exploring visual composition requires generative variation rather than fixed templates

steps.what: Render and refine the final drawings in the chosen medium

tasks.design: Use optional studies from the existing {OTHER} image-editing application for preliminary composition. The artist checks reference fidelity and renders the final work in the chosen medium.
tasks.previous_blocker: Exploring preliminary compositions can require repeated starts.
tasks.enabler_now: Image-generation and editing tools can produce visual studies, without guaranteeing accurate geometry.
tasks.still_hard: Faithful representation, personal style and physical execution.
tasks.human_edge: The artist chooses what the work should express and controls the final rendering.

reach.learn: Reference control and editable image workflows

evidence.claim: Adobe Creative Studio generates and edits images with Content Credentials; this supports preliminary visual studies, not reliable blueprint geometry or physical rendering.
The preliminary-study saving is an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: OTHER means the existing image-editing application; test native generation before custom tools.

In s1 the artist produces subject, composition intent, permitted source references, medium, dimensions and required factual details. Capture and rights checks are counted in 25%; missing reference permission or geometry requires manual work.
Only preliminary exploration changes; physical rendering and reference study keep their time.
No technical accuracy or ownership of generated output is assumed; retain source and generation provenance.
research_questions: Do optional studies help after fidelity checks and manual corrections?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=92.5, gross=7.5%; minus 4 focal upkeep gives net 3.5%. Range 0-1% allows mostly physical work or unsuitable visual studies; E1 scenario.

steps.what: Shade and fill sketch outlines and backgrounds and label designated colors when needed

tasks.design: Retain shading and filling in the chosen physical media with the artist. {DOCS} can hold reference colours, while material application remains fully counted.
tasks.previous_blocker: Physical media and the artist's decisions determine the result.
tasks.enabler_now: Digital image generation does not apply physical washes or markers.
tasks.still_hard: Controlling texture, tone and interaction of materials.

reach.learn: How materials affect colour and texture

evidence.claim: Digital image editing does not establish labour savings in applying physical media.

assumptions: Scope is physical shading and colour application as stated.
The artist chooses colours during counted work; no structured colour plan is assumed free.
Unchanged physical work introduces no upkeep.
research_questions: Which material properties shape the shading process?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross=net=0%. Physical media application retains all time.
